title: FIR Rate Conversion
text: Perform polyphase FIR sample rate conversion, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding method; {Coefficient source} sets the mode of operation, {Interpolation factor}, {FIR filter coefficients}, {Decimation factor}, {Rate options} sets the enforce single-rate or allow multirate processing Enforce single-rate, {Filter object}, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {View Filter Response} sets the visualize filter response, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow handling method, {Coefficients}, {Coefficients Minimum} sets the minimum value of filter coefficients, {Coefficients Maximum} sets the maximum value of filter coefficients, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value the block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Mode of operation Auto (default) | Dialog parameters | Filter object

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Enforce single-rate or allow multirate processing Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Filter object
params.values: Filter object FRC (default) | dsp.FIRRateConverter System object

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding method Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Coefficients data type Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Coefficients Minimum
params.values: Minimum value of filter coefficients [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Coefficients Maximum
params.values: Maximum value of filter coefficients [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value the block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
